issue_request: FHIR-12164 was a Published FHIR-core DSTU2 change request, resolved Persuasive, asking for a new page that reverses the Workgroup/Resource/FMM view so work groups can track their allocated artifacts and each resource's FMM level.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn revision 10273. In git history this is commit efc209e6e465c70a3fda552ba6aaba96ac958d38, '#12164 - page for listing work group FMM levels (wglist.html)', which created source/wglist.html with the FHIR Workgroup List Report and <%wgreport%> placeholder.
additional_context: The current source still includes source/wglist.html, links it from source/qa.html, registers it in source/hierarchy.xml, and lists wglist.html in publish.ini. Active workgroup ownership mappings remain in source/fhir.ini, so the current report is still in build scope and backed by maintained metadata. This later implementation also covers the ownership-listing concern raised earlier in FHIR-5553.
